_comment: Re-sourced player originals. These are official University of Kentucky individual
headshots recovered from Internet Archive captures of ukathletics.com. Each replaces
a crop of a season team photograph — a strip containing two to five people that the
previous build presented as that player's portrait.
Nothing under ../original/ was deleted. Both sources remain on disk so the
substitution can be audited, and scripts/derive-portraits.py records in the photo
manifest which one each portrait was derived from.
'era' is the season the headshot itself dates from, which is not always a season this
archive covers. Where it falls outside 1997-2007 that is stated in the manifest note
and shown in the interface, because the archive must not imply a portrait is
contemporary with the seasons it is displayed beside.
